entries.title: The Currently log
entries.summary: Every change of Petto is posted in this channel when it goes live: a color for each kind of change, a short explanation, and pictures. React with the like or the dislike to tell us what you think. Red is security, yellow a new feature, green something added to a feature, blue an improvement, orange a fix, purple the web and docs, gray something removed and black a feature removed.

entries.title: Top lists of the best partner managers
entries.summary: `{partner.top_list_day}`, `{partner.top_list_week}` and `{partner.top_list_total}` write the five best managers of the day, the week and all time, one per line with their partnerships. Use them in any partner message.

entries.title: Purge in every channel
entries.summary: `/purge` and `!purge` have a new option, `all_channels` (or `!purge everywhere 50 bots`). It scans every text channel where you and Petto can delete, shows how many messages it would delete in each one, and waits for a Confirm click before deleting anything.

entries.title: New command: /mhistory
entries.summary: `/mhistory moderator:<member>` and `!mhistory <moderator>` show the cases a moderator has given. The line of `/case stats` that pointed to it now names a command that exists.

entries.title: A case shows the same icon everywhere
entries.summary: The card of a case (`/case view`, `/case edit`) and the one-line case still used the old icon of each sanction type. They now use the hammer, or the alert for a warning, like the list of cases.

entries.title: /forum outside a post says why
entries.summary: Using `/forum` in a channel that is not a forum post answered with a generic error. It now tells you to use it inside a post.

entries.title: /guildtag and /vanity show in the menu
entries.summary: Discord hid both commands from members without Manage Server, so a moderator could not find them. They now show for everybody and ask for Manage Server when they run.

entries.title: !c opens the cases
entries.summary: `!c <member>` is now a short way of `!case`: it shows the cases of that member.

entries.title: !c is no longer the calculator
entries.summary: `c` was a short word of the calculator, so `!c <id>` answered with a calculation. `!calc` and `!calculate` still work.

entries.title: New blog post: Introducing the Currently log
entries.summary: What the Currently log is, what each color means, how a post looks and what is in the first one. Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

entries.title: A sticky message is posted when you save it
entries.summary: Saving a sticky message in the dashboard now posts it in the channel right away, like `!stickymessage set` does, instead of waiting for somebody to write there first. If you change it, the old message is replaced.

entries.title: Text fields fit their text
entries.summary: Every text field of the site has the height of its text: no corner to drag, it grows as you write and shrinks as you delete, and an empty one is four lines high. Chat boxes keep their own size.
